# Evans Cycles - Online Bike Shop & Stores Nationwide

Enjoy flying up the hills? Start with our range of [road bikes][107]. Or if it's all about tracks
and trails, head to our [mountain bikes][108] for a mix of hardtail and full suspension machines.
We've even got a full range of [hybrid bikes][109] (perfect for commuting), which includes several
[folding bikes][110] - ideal if you're taking the train or you're short on storage space. Still not
sure which bike is for you? Pop into one of our [UK bike stores][111] where our friendly staff will
help, or have a read of our super handy [buying guides][112]

We also stock all the [clothing][113] and [accessories][114] you'll ever need, as well as a wide
range of [parts and components][115] to keep your bike in top-top condition. Plus, shopping with us
gives you lots of great benefits like our Click & Collect. Enjoy the ride.

informed decisions, improve your cycling skills, and have more fun on your next bike ride.

Our content is written by avid cyclists with one aim — to answer any bike-related questions you
might have in a clear, fun, and engaging way.

riders that will help you to:
* Choose the best bike for your needs
* Get the correct bike size
* Learn bike maintenance skills

BILSTEIN Technologies & Competences

We love setting benchmarks. Whether with our high-performance monotube and twin-tube shock absorber
technologies, state-of-the-art air springs or revolutionary electronic systems: With our innovative
technologies, we are shaping the present and the future of damper design. Find out all about the
most exciting BILSTEIN technologies here.

[ More about BILSTEIN technologies ][38]

### The official BILSTEIN product catalogue

As unique as your driving style – just as versatile is our product range. Whether it’s maximum
performance on the road, noticeable comfort in everyday driving, or absolute precision on the
racetrack, our product lines offer the right solution for every demand.

[ View product catalog ][39]
Find BILSTEIN dealers and experts near you

Not only do we pride ourselves in our ability to develop outstanding products, together with our
BILSTEIN experts and dealers, we also value excellent service. Our direct partners are carefully
selected and offer highly qualified service and support in finding the optimum BILSTEIN product for
you. Find a BILSTEIN dealer near you!

[ Find a BILSTEIN partner ][40]

### New look improved packaging

Our BILSTEIN packaging reliably protects original products, supported by a QR code and authenticity
label for more transparency and security. At the same time, it impresses with modern design,
stability, and sustainable production.

[ Discover more ][41]

At BILSTEIN, we manufacture high-quality shock absorbers and suspension systems. As an employer, we
are as innovative as our technologies and as passionate as our customers. Take up the challenge &
realize your potential with us!

eco-friendly mobility solutions that improve lives and protect our planet. Whether the clients are
city commuters, adventure seekers, or looking for a reliable ride for the little ones, Cybic offers
a smarter way to move.

Quality · Innovation · Collaboration · Sustainability

electric and premium bicycles are designed for those who seek eco-friendly transportation options
without compromising on performance or style. 

• With an innate understanding of diverse global needs, we offer customized solutions that go beyond
mere transportation. Our bikes are an extension of your lifestyle, designed to meet the requirements
of every rider.

• Our facilities are equipped with advanced intelligent manufacturing technologies. This robust
production capability allows us to deliver high-quality bicycles with precision and efficiency.

• Cybic stands by every product, offering exceptional post-purchase services. From our seamless
backend management system to our detailed maintenance procedures, we ensure a smooth and enjoyable
ride for every customer.

regular bicycles to life.

Innovations & News

# XD15 Lifetime Bearings

[Enduro XD15 lifetime bearing]

**An Enduro exclusive, XD15 Ceramic-Hybrid bearings** utilize an advanced, nitrogen-infused
stainless alloy that will never rust or corrode. A material so tough that should grit find its way
inside, it simply polishes the bearing races smoother. Backed by a lifetime guarantee, XD15 bearings
are available for a wide range of bottom bracket, wheel hub and headset applications.

# Maxhit™ Components

[Maxhit-technology-image.2.png__PID:20901bce-0773-4e74-a530-a03b2ff4119a]

**Enduro’s game-changing Maxhit™** bearing components are patent-pending and guaranteed for life.
Machined entirely from 440C Stainless Steel, Maxhit bearing components eliminate the aluminum cups
traditionally used to carry the bearings, freeing-up space for much larger balls that easily support
double the load of standard headset and bottom bracket bearings.

# MAX^{®} Pivot Bearings

[Enduro XD15 lifetime bearing]

**Enduro’s MAX^{®} Full-Compliment** pivot bearings are the most battle tested, OE spec’d MTB
bearings in the world. By removing the bearing retainer and completely ﬁlling the bearing races with
balls, load capacity is increased 35% to 40% which dramatically improves reliability and longevity.

# Torqtite Threaded Press-fit Solutions

[Enduro Torqtite BB solution]

**Torqtite, an Enduro innovation**, is a precision, thread-together bottom bracket solution that
improves bearing-to-spindle alignment and eliminate annoying noises common with press-fit solutions.
Available for a wide range of non-threaded, press-fit applications with two angular contact bearing
performance options: 440C Stainless Steel and XD15 Ceramic-Hybrid.

# Directline™ Derailleur Pulleys

[Enduro Directline derailleur pulleys]

**Enduro Directline™ Pulleys** with XD15 Ceramic-Hybrid bearings perform flawlessly and tirelessly
in adverse conditions and are covered by a lifetime warranty. Precision machined from Teflon infused
500 AF Delrin, Directline™ pulleys reduce drivetrain friction while offering precise shifting
and significantly less drag than aluminum or titanium pulleys.

# What's New!

[Enduro Directline derailleur pulleys]

**Enduro bearinglife** provides the latest developments with products, innovations, testing,
ambassadors and events.

Innovations & News

# XD15 Lifetime Bearings

[Enduro XD15 lifetime bearing]

**An Enduro exclusive, XD15 Ceramic-Hybrid bearings** utilize an advanced, nitrogen-infused
stainless alloy that will never rust or corrode. A material so tough that should grit find its way
inside, it simply polishes the bearing races smoother. Backed by a lifetime guarantee, XD15 bearings
are available for a wide range of bottom bracket, wheel hub and headset applications.

# Maxhit™ Components

[Maxhit-technology-image.2.png__PID:20901bce-0773-4e74-a530-a03b2ff4119a]

**Enduro’s game-changing Maxhit™** bearing components are patent-pending and guaranteed for life.
Machined entirely from 440C Stainless Steel, Maxhit bearing components eliminate the aluminum cups
traditionally used to carry the bearings, freeing-up space for much larger balls that easily support
double the load of standard headset and bottom bracket bearings.

# MAX^{®} Pivot Bearings

[Enduro XD15 lifetime bearing]

**Enduro’s MAX^{®} Full-Compliment** pivot bearings are the most battle tested, OE spec’d MTB
bearings in the world. By removing the bearing retainer and completely ﬁlling the bearing races with
balls, load capacity is increased 35% to 40% which dramatically improves reliability and longevity.

# Torqtite Threaded Press-fit Solutions

[Enduro Torqtite BB solution]

**Torqtite, an Enduro innovation**, is a precision, thread-together bottom bracket solution that
improves bearing-to-spindle alignment and eliminate annoying noises common with press-fit solutions.
Available for a wide range of non-threaded, press-fit applications with two angular contact bearing
performance options: 440C Stainless Steel and XD15 Ceramic-Hybrid.

# Directline™ Derailleur Pulleys

[Enduro Directline derailleur pulleys]

**Enduro Directline™ Pulleys** with XD15 Ceramic-Hybrid bearings perform flawlessly and tirelessly
in adverse conditions and are covered by a lifetime warranty. Precision machined from Teflon infused
500 AF Delrin, Directline™ pulleys reduce drivetrain friction while offering precise shifting
and significantly less drag than aluminum or titanium pulleys.

# What's New!

[Enduro Directline derailleur pulleys]

**Enduro bearinglife** provides the latest developments with products, innovations, testing,
ambassadors and events.

YOUR TOYOTA TRUCK AND SUV SPECIALIST

 

DeMello off-road has been building and installing products for your Toyota Truck and SUV's for over
20 years. We pride ourselves on designing, engineering, and building all our products in the USA. We
started off in a one car garage and have grown our business to a worldwide supplier of Toyota Armor
and SoCal’s premier installer for parts.  When you need a Toyota truck and SUV specialist in
Riverside, CA, we're the team to call.

We also do full off-road builds for whatever your off-road needs are. From overlanding and exploring
your favorite trails or rock crawling and conquering the biggest mountain, even if it is just a mall
crawler we got you covered. Our expert team of build analyst and installers do everything the right
way, no shortcuts are taken. We can walk you through every step of the process and get you
everything you need for your truck or SUV. For quality Toyota truck and SUV parts in Riverside, CA,
give us a call today!

Call Text or e-mail us anytime to start your journey

#### ENDURO Mountainbike Magazine

ENDURO ist das führende Magazin für Mountainbike-Technologie und modernen Trail-Lifestyle. Wir
berichten über High-End-Bikes, globale Trends und technische Innovationen – fundiert, mutig und
immer mit dem Blick für das große Ganze. Unsere Redaktion richtet sich an alle, die das
Mountainbiken nicht nur als Sport, sondern als Lebensgefühl verstehen. Statt Bikes auf starre
Kategorien oder Federwege zu reduzieren, bewerten wir Produkte konsequent aus der Lebensrealität
unserer Leserschaft: von epischen Alpentouren bis hin zu harten Trail-Einsätzen.

Seit 2011 steht ENDURO für journalistische Qualität und transparente Berichterstattung im
MTB-Segment. In unseren aufwändigen Einzel- und Vergleichstests bringt unser spezialisiertes
Test-Team jahrelange Trail-Erfahrung aus aller Welt ein, um objektive Urteile zu fällen und
Radbegeisterten echte Orientierungshilfe zu leisten. Unsere Awards gelten international als Maßstab
für Innovation und Qualität in der Bike-Industrie und bieten sowohl Leserinnen und Lesern als auch
Handel und Herstellern eine verlässliche Einordnung.

ENDURO erscheint auf Deutsch sowie Englisch und erreicht eine internationale Leserschaft.

#### ENDURO Mountainbike Magazine

ENDURO ist das führende Magazin für Mountainbike-Technologie und modernen Trail-Lifestyle. Wir
berichten über High-End-Bikes, globale Trends und technische Innovationen – fundiert, mutig und
immer mit dem Blick für das große Ganze. Unsere Redaktion richtet sich an alle, die das
Mountainbiken nicht nur als Sport, sondern als Lebensgefühl verstehen. Statt Bikes auf starre
Kategorien oder Federwege zu reduzieren, bewerten wir Produkte konsequent aus der Lebensrealität
unserer Leserschaft: von epischen Alpentouren bis hin zu harten Trail-Einsätzen.

Seit 2011 steht ENDURO für journalistische Qualität und transparente Berichterstattung im
MTB-Segment. In unseren aufwändigen Einzel- und Vergleichstests bringt unser spezialisiertes
Test-Team jahrelange Trail-Erfahrung aus aller Welt ein, um objektive Urteile zu fällen und
Radbegeisterten echte Orientierungshilfe zu leisten. Unsere Awards gelten international als Maßstab
für Innovation und Qualität in der Bike-Industrie und bieten sowohl Leserinnen und Lesern als auch
Handel und Herstellern eine verlässliche Einordnung.

ENDURO erscheint auf Deutsch sowie Englisch und erreicht eine internationale Leserschaft.

We get it—you want to drop your car, lift your truck, or simply dial in that perfect stance,
and still enjoy a confident, comfortable ride. That’s not asking too much in our book.
Function and Form Suspension has been committed since 2005 to engineering suspension systems
that strike the ideal balance between performance and comfort—perfect for everything from your
daily driver to your weekend build. Whether you’re lowering for show, lifting for clearance,
or looking to fine-tune the feel of your ride, our parts put you in control.

Built and tested in Southern California by real enthusiasts with over 18 years of experience,
our products are made to look good, perform great, and go the distance. Our lineup now goes beyond
just coilovers—we offer adjustable and fixed coilovers, air suspension systems, leveling lift kits,
and an expanding range of suspension accessories. Whether you need wheel spacers for a wider stance,
lug nuts that complete the look, or OEM-equivalent sway bar endlinks to restore handling, we’ve got
what you need to complete your setup from top to bottom.

We get it—you want to drop your car, lift your truck, or simply dial in that perfect stance,
and still enjoy a confident, comfortable ride. That’s not asking too much in our book.
Function and Form Suspension has been committed since 2005 to engineering suspension systems
that strike the ideal balance between performance and comfort—perfect for everything from your
daily driver to your weekend build. Whether you’re lowering for show, lifting for clearance,
or looking to fine-tune the feel of your ride, our parts put you in control.

Built and tested in Southern California by real enthusiasts with over 18 years of experience,
our products are made to look good, perform great, and go the distance. Our lineup now goes beyond
just coilovers—we offer adjustable and fixed coilovers, air suspension systems, leveling lift kits,
and an expanding range of suspension accessories. Whether you need wheel spacers for a wider stance,
lug nuts that complete the look, or OEM-equivalent sway bar endlinks to restore handling, we’ve got
what you need to complete your setup from top to bottom.

As a consumer in the European Union, you have the right to withdraw from your purchase within 14
days of receiving your order, without giving any reason.

### Your Rights Under EU Directive 2023/2673
* You have the right to withdraw from this contract within 14 days without giving any reason.
* The withdrawal period will expire after 14 days from the day on which you acquire physical
  possession of the goods.
* To exercise the right of withdrawal, you must inform us of your decision by means of a clear
  statement.
* If you withdraw from this contract, we shall reimburse all payments received from you, including
  delivery costs (except for supplementary costs if you chose a type of delivery other than the
  least expensive type of standard delivery offered by us).
* We may withhold reimbursement until we have received the goods back or you have supplied evidence
  of having sent back the goods, whichever is the earliest.

### Exceptions

The right of withdrawal does not apply to:
* Goods that are personalized or made to your specifications
* Sealed goods which are not suitable for return due to health protection or hygiene reasons
* Goods which have been inseparably mixed with other items after delivery
* Digital content supplied if performance has begun with your prior express consent

* You have the right to withdraw from this contract within 14 days without giving any reason.

# Live Air Quality Map

Real-time air quality data from over 80,000 monitoring sensors worldwide.

## **Klaus Hammes**

Visionary and pioneer in clean air

April 7, 1939 - April 30, 2026

With the passing of Klaus Hammes, IQAir has lost its visionary founder, who, from the 1960s through
the 1990s, improved air quality for people around the world through the innovative use of air filter
technology in buildings and vehicles. Klaus Hammes was a pioneer of the Indoor Air Quality (IAQ),
Cleantech and HealthTech industries and continues to inspire the work of IQAir to this day.

## Clean air solutions. Proven protection.

Trusted by hospitals, schools, and families worldwide, IQAir air purifiers remove ultrafine
particles down to 0.003 microns — the smallest particles that impact your health the most.
Experience cleaner, healthier air in every room.

Our experts are ready to help. Tour IQAir technology and learn how clean air solutions work in real
environments.

Call [**+1 877-304-7247**][86] to book a [**virtual**][87] or [**in-person**][88] appointment or
just [**walk in**][89].

[Visit the Center][90]

IQAir partners with leading medical, environmental, and government institutions to advance clean-air
technology and global air quality research.

## **Klaus Hammes**

Visionary and pioneer in clean air

April 7, 1939 - April 30, 2026

With the passing of Klaus Hammes, IQAir has lost its visionary founder, who, from the 1960s through
the 1990s, improved air quality for people around the world through the innovative use of air filter
technology in buildings and vehicles. Klaus Hammes was a pioneer of the Indoor Air Quality (IAQ),
Cleantech and HealthTech industries and continues to inspire the work of IQAir to this day.

## Clean air solutions. Proven protection.

Trusted by hospitals, schools, and families worldwide, IQAir air purifiers remove ultrafine
particles down to 0.003 microns — the smallest particles that impact your health the most.

NEW PRODUCT

### Introducing KONI EXPLORER

The all-new EXPLORER offroad shock absorber pair KONI’s patented FSD technology with a robust 2-inch
aluminum monotube construction, designed to conquer any terrain the unbeaten path leads.

[ LEARN MORE ][93]
[KONI HYDRORIDE Shock Absorber]

TECHNOLOGY HIGHLIGHT

### HYDRORIDE®

KONI isn't just a leader in Car and Camper shock absorbers, we engineer complete ride solutions for
heavy duty vehicles. HYDRORIDE® brings together damping, load support, and ride height control in
one compact system, using a high pressure gas spring to deliver a naturally progressive response as
loads increase. The result is improved stability, easier ingress and egress, reduced system weight,
and consistent performance in the most demanding environments. It's a smarter, more capable approach
to suspension, built on KONI expertise.

[ LEARN ABOUT HYDRORIDE® ][94]

THE KONI ADVANTAGE

### Engineers, Manufacturers, Innovators

KONI has been the authority in suspension, manufacturing shock absorbers and solving suspension
requirements for customers around the world. Why is suspension important? What is the difference
between and Original Equipment (O.E.) product and a KONI or aftermarket product? Learn why specially
developed and engineered suspension is important for you and your vehicle.

KONI HISTORY

### A Legacy of Performance

With over 150 years of engineering excellence, KONI has built a legacy rooted in performance,
precision, and innovation. As a global leader in suspension technology, KONI delivers cutting-edge
solutions trusted by drivers, racers, and manufacturers worldwide. From performance cars and
off-road trucks to defense vehicles, KONI’s commitment to quality ensures unmatched ride control and
lasting durability.

[ Dime Brake Lever Blades ][217] Armin
****

I have meaty fingers and these help with the levers not stressing and cutting into my fingers
causing fatigue. I love the one finger stopping leverage that these provide. Great product!

K
[ Lift V2 Damper Upgrade Kit for RockShox Forks ][218] Kenneth Fleck
**Night and Day**

Replaced a charger 2 in a Lyrik with this Lift Damper. Much smoother ride, hand numbness is gone and
it still handles drops and corners really good. Very responsive to rebound and damping adjustments,
glad I made this choice and now have no regrets.

N
[ Lift V2 Damper Upgrade Kit for Fox and Marzocchi Forks ][219] Nate H.
**Transformed my bike!**

I'm riding a Canyon Strive:ON with the Fox Grip fork which was underwhelming at best. I originally
planned to swap out the damper to the Fox X2 but the simplicity and weight specific tune caught my
attention. Read some very positive reviews and pulled the trigger. Installation wasn't a big deal
and the ride after install was insane. Literally PR'd all my local spots after install and that
isn't BS. The bike just feels planted through everything. Could not be happier and this was just the
refresh this bike needed to squeeze some more life out of it before an upgrade. Super stoked! Just
get the damn thing, you will not regret it.

C
[ Lift V2 Damper Upgrade Kit for Fox and Marzocchi Forks ][220] Cameron O
**As Advertised!**

Bought this after being endlessly frustrated with my Grip 2 damper. Took a couple rides to dial in
but feels just as I was hoping it would!

## **EXCEPTIONAL SHOCK ABSORBERS** MADE IN BRITAIN

### 60 Years Experience

Spax patented on car adjustable shock absorbers and have been supplying upgraded suspension to
Manufacturers, Race Teams, Restorers and Enthusiasts since the 1960’s. Our global network of OEM’s,
dealers and specialist mechanics supply on-car adjustable shock absorbers to upgrade original
equipment and help accurately tune suspension, allowing our customers to drive with increased
confidence on the roads, and win on the track.

### Krypton Gas Pressurised

Krypton gas pressurised, dampers offer users the ability to tune suspension for the optimum car
configuration / conditions / driving style combination. Gas pressurisation ensures minimum damper
fade, a broader performance envelope and increased low speed response and feel.

### On-Car Adjustable

Our telescopic dampers and coil-overs offer adjustable bump and rebound damping response ensuring
ride stiffness adjustment takes seconds, on-car with no dismantling required.

## **5000+** SPAX CATALOGUE AND PRICELIST

We’ve built up huge experience over the years and our catalogue contains over 5000 high-quality
suspension components. These dampers, suspension and spring kits are all well developed parts, built
in a TüV certified factory. All our part / vehicle compbinations have been tested to ensure that the
Spax part number easily swaps out with Original Equipment to provide an instant, adjustable, upgrade
to the cars suspension. We have NO minimum order quantity and NO requirement for you to hold stock.

If the part number is listed against the car then the combination has been tested and proven to
work!

Every part tested on the applicable car

Gas pressurised to prevent fade

Shock absorbers are on-car adjustable

Double Powder Coated – 2 year warranty

confidence on the roads, and win on the track.

### Krypton Gas Pressurised

Krypton gas pressurised, dampers offer users the ability to tune suspension for the optimum car
configuration / conditions / driving style combination. Gas pressurisation ensures minimum damper
fade, a broader performance envelope and increased low speed response and feel.

### On-Car Adjustable

Our telescopic dampers and coil-overs offer adjustable bump and rebound damping response ensuring
ride stiffness adjustment takes seconds, on-car with no dismantling required.

## **5000+** SPAX CATALOGUE AND PRICELIST

We’ve built up huge experience over the years and our catalogue contains over 5000 high-quality
suspension components. These dampers, suspension and spring kits are all well developed parts, built
in a TüV certified factory. All our part / vehicle compbinations have been tested to ensure that the
Spax part number easily swaps out with Original Equipment to provide an instant, adjustable, upgrade
to the cars suspension. We have NO minimum order quantity and NO requirement for you to hold stock.

If the part number is listed against the car then the combination has been tested and proven to
work!

Every part tested on the applicable car

Gas pressurised to prevent fade

Shock absorbers are on-car adjustable

Double Powder Coated – 2 year warranty

[Download Catalogue][16]

## **SPAX PERFORMANCE!** RACING PEDIGREE


#### On the track it's winning that counts ! There's nothing like the feeling when you've pulled out
#### all the stops to beat the competition & we've helped drivers do that season after season, we
#### look forward to helping you out corner the grid using our single or double adjustable
#### competition dampers

[Spax TrakSpax DA Competition Dampers]

### TrakSpax

[Spax have 60 years Racing Pedigree & TrakSpax Dampers represent the pinnacle of affordable
competition shocks][17]
[1988_audi_quattro_with Spax Struts and Inserts.jpg]

### Racing Struts

[Our RSX single adjustable kits are designed to fit a range of performance cars to dramatically
improve stability][18]
[Alfa Romeo sold at Auction fitted with Spax Shock Absorbers]

### Improved Handling

[Spax have designed dampers to be competitive when racing at all levels, and in cars old and
new!][19]
[TrakSpax put to good use]

### Teamwork

[We're here as an extension of your team, we're proud that so many customers insist on Spax season
after season][20]
[1973 JPS Lotus Europa fitted with Spax Shocks]

### Built to Last

[We build shocks every day to upgrade dampers fitted to every vintage and class of race car][21]
[SPAX RSX Coilover Suspension Upgrade Kit for VW Polo]

### Spax RSX Suspension Kits

[Using Spax Coilovers & carefully selected Racing Springs RSX Kits are ideal for Trackday use &
Clubman Racing][22]
[NSU fitted with Spax Competition Shocks]

### Not Just the Familiar

[We supply suspension upgrades for every type of car, give us a call on 01869 244 771][23]
[GC285 driven by Spax founder Jeremy Rossiter]

### Le Mans Racer

[Jeremy Rossiter, founder of Spax, competing at Le Mans][24]
[Spax Aluminium TrakSpax Racing Shocks]

### Aluminium TrakSpax

[Our lightweight aluminium dampers offer exception stroke to length ratio][25]
[image]

### Racing Struts

[Our RSX single adjustable kits are designed to fit a range of performance cars to dramatically
improve stability][26]
[alpine A110 1600S Gr4 using spax damper conversion]

### Using Standard Spax

[Many Renault Alpine customers successfuly race on standard Spax single adjustable G dampers][27]
[Honda Civic with Spax Upgrade Suspension Kit]

### Spax Catalogue

[Racing using single adjustable coilover kit from the Spax Catalogue][28]
[SPAX CSX spec your own coilvers with bumpstop]

### CSX CoilOvers

[Single adjustable Spax CSX Coilovers, built to your specifications...][29]
[Spax Adjustable Shocks on Cobra]

### Worldwide Presence

[Our global network of dealers & specialist mechanics supply our customers wherever they're
located][30]
[TrakSpax employed to best effect]

### Raceday

[When the margins are tight Spax adjustable dampers enable drivers to fine tune their suspension
set-up][31]
[Tiger Blyton racing hard using Spax CSX coilovers]

### Bespoke Coilovers

[A Tiger Blyton racing hard, shod with Spax CSX Coilover Shocks][32]
[Reynard running TrakSpax Shocks]

### Steel Shocks

[Spax TrakSpax racing shocks are available in all steel for those historic series which insist on
authentic dampers][33]
[Spax Bespoke Double Adjustable]

### Bespoke DA Shocks

[Our consultancy engineering service develops complete solutions to your specifications][34]
[Lotus Elise fitted with Spax Dampers]

### Lotus Elise

[Fitted with Spax Coilovers, we'll work with you to provide the ideal suspension set-up][35]
[1966 MALLOCK U2 MK6 fitted with Spax Shock Absorbers]

### Mallock

[We've been working with Mallock for years, they're always a popular choice!][36]

## **ADVANTAGE SPAX** WHY BUY OUR PRODUCTS ?

### Proven Quality

The **knowledge and experieince gained over 60** years in business is evident in the breadth and
quailty of our range with thousands of compatible parts

### Built to Order

**We provide on-demand manufacture** with no minimum quantity requirement, no demand for
stock-holding and an average one week lead time

### TüV Certified

**We manufacture to exacting TüV standards.** Every damper hand-built in England, we don’t
sub-contract production overseas and are proud of our audited 99.99% reliability

### Better by Design

**Our dampers are on-car adjustable providing tuned set-up** & Krypton gas pressurised to prevent
fade – longevity, performance, roadholding and driver confidence will all be upgraded from original
equipment

### Bespoke Dampers

**Products Designed to your Specification!** We can build telescopic and coilover dampers to your
dimensions and valve them to suit your application, DELIVERED IN ONE WEEKe

### Price / Performance

**Spax offer exceptional value for money!** Our products consistently out perform competitive
equipment costing many times more, offering tuned performance designed to give you the edge in
roadholding without braking the bank

## **SPAX PERFORMANCE** DAMPERS & SUSPENSION UPGRADE KITS

#### “The Spax range of proven upgrade suspension products represents outstanding value, compatible
#### with a huge variety of cars, old and new”

### RSX Suspension Kits

#### PERFORMANCE COIL-OVER & RACE SPRING KITS

Ride Height & Stiffness Adjustable Suspension Kits provide damping adjustment and corner weight
setting for stable, fade free, high speed roadholding ensuring Ultimate Performance.

### PSX Suspension Kits

#### ADJUSTABLE STIFFNESS LOWERING KITS

Adjustable, Krypton gas pressurised, damping - combined with quality lowering spring kits -
significantly improve looks & suspension set-up, allow drivers to adjust damping response

### VSX Suspension Kits

#### SPORT UPGRADE DAMPER & LOWERING SPRING KITS

Nitrogen pressurised fixed rate upgrade shock absorbers & lowering spring kits - enhance looks and
improve handling & performance

### SSX Spring Kits

#### OPTIMISED SPRING RATES WITH PROGRESSIVELY WOUND COILS

Quality Chrome Silicon Steel Spring Lowering Kits - oven cured & epoxy powder coated, fantastic
aesthetics, excellent value

## Your Questions, Answered

What is the different between the ProFlex range and the Classic range?

[ProFlex][146] is the world’s most advanced vertical pivoting bike rack. Featuring a new modern
aesthetic, increased load capacity (can now hold bikes up to 55kg/121lbs), a [SteadySpine][147]
which allows for the seamless integration of the new [GearMate][148] storage organizer system,
removable rear tire rest allowing for the mounting plate to be used with future products (watch this
space) as well as new SteadySaddle which allows for bikes with fenders or mudguards. Basically the
ProFlex does everything the Classic does and more!

Can I use my Classic Range Rack with GearMate?

Yes, the GearMate is designed to work seamlessly with all Classic racks (Road, MTB, Fat, Fender).
You will just need to purchase the [GearMate Classic Range Bundle][149] to ensure you get the
SteadySpine, which allows for the GearMate products to attach and install.

How far will my bike stick out from the wall when pivoted against the wall?

It really depends on the width of your handlebars and the pedals. It will fold until the handlebars
touch the wall but not quite 90 degrees or flat to the wall. For a normal road bike bar, we would
allow about 400mm or around 16 inches, and for a MTB with wider bars probably around 1m or 39 inches
(give or take).

Are Steadyracks bike racks safe to use for bikes with hydraulic brakes/forks/suspension?

This is a common concern for many bike owners with these types of brakes and suspension. When your
bike is hung up vertically, the fluid in your forks will run towards the seals and keep them
lubricated. This will prolong their use, so it's actually good for your bike and forks to hang it
vertically on our bike racks.

If you have hydraulic brakes on your bike, the fluid will run down when the bike is hung, so we
advise pumping the brakes a few times when you take the bike off the rack if it's been there for a
while. The shocks shouldn't leak when the bike is hung up, however if they do it's a good indication
that the seals may need replacing.

We have done the research and spoken to several of the major brake and fork component manufacturers
about this issue and the universal response is that hanging bikes up vertically does not cause the
brakes or suspension forks to develop leaks. In fact many of the major bike and component
manufacturers use and recommend our racks for storing bikes or parking staff bikes in their
headquarters or both. As long as proper maintenance is completed on the bike and there are no
pre-existing issues, then you will experience no issues. You may need to pump the brakes a bit if
the bike has been in the rack for awhile, however, it is perfectly safe.

Read our [blog post][150] for more information about storing bikes with hydraulic brakes in
Steadyracks.

How far apart do I hang each rack?

Spacing your racks depends on whether you want to save floor space, wall space, or a bit of both.
We've created a handy [Wall Placement Guide][151] to help.

## Your Questions, Answered

What is the different between the ProFlex range and the Classic range?

[ProFlex][146] is the world’s most advanced vertical pivoting bike rack. Featuring a new modern
aesthetic, increased load capacity (can now hold bikes up to 55kg/121lbs), a [SteadySpine][147]
which allows for the seamless integration of the new [GearMate][148] storage organizer system,
removable rear tire rest allowing for the mounting plate to be used with future products (watch this
space) as well as new SteadySaddle which allows for bikes with fenders or mudguards. Basically the
ProFlex does everything the Classic does and more!

Can I use my Classic Range Rack with GearMate?

Yes, the GearMate is designed to work seamlessly with all Classic racks (Road, MTB, Fat, Fender).
You will just need to purchase the [GearMate Classic Range Bundle][149] to ensure you get the
SteadySpine, which allows for the GearMate products to attach and install.

How far will my bike stick out from the wall when pivoted against the wall?

It really depends on the width of your handlebars and the pedals. It will fold until the handlebars
touch the wall but not quite 90 degrees or flat to the wall. For a normal road bike bar, we would
allow about 400mm or around 16 inches, and for a MTB with wider bars probably around 1m or 39 inches
(give or take).

Are Steadyracks bike racks safe to use for bikes with hydraulic brakes/forks/suspension?

This is a common concern for many bike owners with these types of brakes and suspension. When your
bike is hung up vertically, the fluid in your forks will run towards the seals and keep them
lubricated. This will prolong their use, so it's actually good for your bike and forks to hang it
vertically on our bike racks.

If you have hydraulic brakes on your bike, the fluid will run down when the bike is hung, so we
advise pumping the brakes a few times when you take the bike off the rack if it's been there for a
while. The shocks shouldn't leak when the bike is hung up, however if they do it's a good indication
that the seals may need replacing.

We have done the research and spoken to several of the major brake and fork component manufacturers
about this issue and the universal response is that hanging bikes up vertically does not cause the
brakes or suspension forks to develop leaks. In fact many of the major bike and component
manufacturers use and recommend our racks for storing bikes or parking staff bikes in their
headquarters or both. As long as proper maintenance is completed on the bike and there are no
pre-existing issues, then you will experience no issues. You may need to pump the brakes a bit if
the bike has been in the rack for awhile, however, it is perfectly safe.

Read our [blog post][150] for more information about storing bikes with hydraulic brakes in
Steadyracks.

How far apart do I hang each rack?

Spacing your racks depends on whether you want to save floor space, wall space, or a bit of both.
We've created a handy [Wall Placement Guide][151] to help.

# ABOUT THE LAB

Trail Labs is a different kind of bike shop, specializing in factory level mountain bike suspension
service and aftermarket sales.  We focus on prompt, accurately scheduled service, and pride
ourselves on following manufacturer's guidelines for servicing components.  We are professionally
trained by the industry leaders in suspension and have over 20 years experience in the cycling and
automotive industry.

You can schedule your service directly with us on our convenient booking system.  Bike shops can
also arrange for your components to be delivered to us.

Our retail branch stocks a specially curated selection of products that we recommend as quality
upgrades.  All of the suspension products we offer are products that we have experience servicing
and riding.  When you buy from us we'll support you with setup answers and tuning options, where
applicable.  Don't settle for anything less.

Trail Labs is located in Springfield, Missouri.  Visit our shop if you're in the area!

automotive industry.
